scope: Non-blinded source-based qualitative review of all final answers; separate from location coverage. Not a statistical answer-correctness score.

labels.consistent: No material contradiction of the requested behavior identified; minor omissions may remain.
labels.mixed: Requested flow mostly explained but a concrete error or important omission is present.
labels.insufficient: A requested responsibility is absent or substantially misdescribed.

kiro-incomplete-search-status: Unreadable candidates differ from documented skipped files and completed negative reads.
Read/resource failures make lexical scan Partial; invalid input/discovery can be Error; complete no-match is Complete.
CLI scout_result converts Complete to exit 0 and other statuses to exit 1; scout compatibility wrapper drops status.
MCP calls scout_report and sets isError from top-level lexical status, while structured status/counts/references survive budget0.
Zero-budget text is empty, not a surviving truncated marker. Do not invent a CLI --budget option or confuse syntax/display incompleteness with lexical failure.
validation-flow: Formatter priority route, then instance, then default; public customization validated and bound.
attachValidation defaults false: error stops request; true attaches request.validationError and continues preHandler/handler.
Default status400 and code FST_ERR_VALIDATION are fallbacks via ||, not unconditional overwrites; validation/context metadata retained.
shutdown-drain: Closing flag and route closing precede preClose; connection handling and server.close follow with relevant guards.
HTTP1 Connection: close while draining;503 only if return503OnClosing, default true; false continues.
Capability detection selects idle default if supported, otherwise false; unavailable explicit idle rejected.

Force close uses closeAllConnections if available, otherwise tracked sockets; Set only for forced legacy fallback. Respect listening/serverFactory guards rather than claiming every branch unconditional.
